blurb: Chasin' Tides Charters offers fishing trips in Ocean City, Maryland, including bay fishing for families and beginners, inshore shark and wreck fishing, and offshore trips targeting tuna, mahi-mahi, tilefish, and more. They also provide scuba diving charters to explore offshore wrecks and marine life. Their fleet includes three boats equipped for different fishing experiences, with all gear and tackle provided.
